sections.content: You know the present subjunctive after wishes and hopes from A2 Unit 27. With *esperar que*, *querer que*, *desear que* and *ojalá*, the verb of the second clause is in the subjunctive and normally has a different subject. This lesson adds the words *deseo*, *conseguir* and *alcanzar*.

items.spanish: Espero que todo salga bien porque hemos preparado el viaje con cuidado.
items.english: I hope everything goes well, because we've prepared the trip carefully.

items.spanish: Quiero que llegues temprano porque tenemos una cita.
items.english: I want you to arrive early because we have an appointment.

items.spanish: Ojalá encontremos una solución para todos.
items.english: I hope we find a solution for everyone.

items.spanish: Deseo que tengas tiempo para descansar cuando termine el proyecto.
items.english: I hope you have time to rest when the project is over.

sections.content: *Ojalá* always takes the subjunctive, with or without *que*: *Ojalá (que) encontremos una solución*. The word comes from an Arabic phrase meaning roughly "if God wills".
